collections.title: Bible & Faith
collections.summary: Interactive projects centered on Scripture knowledge, memorization, Biblical Greek, global mission, and informed prayer.
collections.editorialNote: A collection spanning repeated engagement with Scripture and outward-looking Christian mission: memorize the text, retrieve biblical knowledge, learn to read the Greek New Testament, and explore peoples and languages in order to pray with greater understanding.
relationshipLabels: Memorization ↔ retrieval play
TMS60 develops exact verse recall; The Bible Challenge exercises broader Scripture knowledge under playful retrieval pressure.
Scripture recall ↔ original language
Both return repeatedly to biblical text, with one emphasizing exact memorization and the other building the grammar needed to read Greek directly.
Scripture study ↔ mission
Koinē Path deepens engagement with the New Testament text while Unreached turns biblical mission concern outward toward peoples, languages, and prayer.
Knowledge ↔ global context
Bible knowledge becomes broader Christian context when paired with exploration of peoples, gospel access, languages, and prayer needs.

collections.title: Browser Games
collections.summary: Games and hosted play experiences that run directly in the browser, from precision arcade play to surreal 3D worlds and long-form systems.
collections.editorialNote: A cross-section of how far browser play can be pushed: a 31-game instant-play arcade, precision typing games, social quiz formats, long-form incremental systems, atmospheric action, and a complete first-person 3D journey. The collection is organized by play pattern rather than by a single genre.
relationshipLabels: Focused arcade play
Micro Arcade collects many short-form game loops in one shell, while Wordstrike develops a single precision typing mechanic into a dedicated arcade experience.
Typing as the core mechanic
Both transform keyboard accuracy into immediate game action, but use different spatial pressure models.
Precision under pressure
Both reward fast, exact input and immediate correction, with one centered on typing and the other on spatial cuts.
Systems & progression
Both ask the player to read systems, make trade-offs, and build value over repeated decisions.
Social quiz play
Both turn questions into group-friendly play, with one centered on Bible knowledge and the other on flexible quiz-night hosting.
Atmosphere & space
Both use audiovisual atmosphere and unusual spatial rules to make browser play feel more like a fully authored game world.
Long-run progression
Both support sessions where accumulating progression changes how later play feels.

collections.title: French Learning
collections.summary: Vocabulary and structured course practice for learning French across complementary browser-based systems.
collections.editorialNote: Two complementary layers of language acquisition: a broad spaced-repetition vocabulary system and a guided course-like environment for grammar, reading, and structured practice.
relationshipLabels: Vocabulary → guided practice
French 3000 supplies breadth; Le Carnet places that vocabulary inside structured grammar, reading, and course practice.

collections.title: Productivity & Creation
collections.summary: Practical tools for documents, publishing, and structured everyday workflows.
collections.editorialNote: Three tools built around turning messy inputs into controlled outputs: PDF Studio manipulates finished documents, Manuscript turns source text into publication-ready pages, and Clean30 turns an everyday environment into a finite workflow. The shared idea is structured transformation.
relationshipLabels: Finished documents ↔ source publishing
PDF Studio operates on existing documents; Manuscript creates polished documents from structured source.
Structured workflow
Both reduce a larger task into explicit ordered steps with visible progress toward a finished state.
Local task completion
Both emphasize direct local control, clear completion states, and practical work over account-driven collaboration.

collections.title: Typing Games
collections.summary: Fast browser games where keyboard accuracy and reaction speed are the core mechanic.
collections.editorialNote: Two experiments in making typing itself the game rather than a supporting control scheme. WORDSTRIKE uses whole incoming words and a central core; Wordfall turns typed targets into a different spatial defense rhythm. The connection is mechanical, not merely thematic.
relationshipLabels: Typing-driven defense
Both convert correct keyboard input into defense actions while using distinct target motion and pacing.
